scope: Remaining resource, appendix, chart, form, job action sheet, map, workbook, and quick-reference items after prose drafting batches.
principles: Preserve function and intent, not legacy Word or Excel visual design.
Keep Markdown as the native authoring wrapper.
Use structured artifact blocks or sidecars for fields, rows, formulas, choices, repeat groups, and chart nodes.
Use HTML/CSS templates for PDF and print rendering, especially for fixed-page forms, charts, worksheets, and wide quick references.
Favor digital-friendly controls such as checkboxes, dropdowns, date/time inputs, repeatable records, attachments, and calculated outputs.

visual_evidence.note: Visual inspection used generated PDFs, layout text, and page images created from the original Word/Excel sources. Intermediate render files are not retained; contact sheets are kept as durable evidence and sources can be regenerated from the original files.
